module_summary: Small register-file memory: flattened D x W array written synchronously per row on we/wa match, read asynchronously by ra slice.

anchors.name: slab
anchors.why: Flattened D-entry storage array, row written with wd, sliced for read.

anchors.name: wd
anchors.why: Write data stored into selected row.

anchors.name: rd
anchors.why: Asynchronous read data selected by ra.

anchors.name: we
anchors.why: Write enable gating the row update.

anchors.name: wa
anchors.why: Write address selecting which row is written.

anchors.name: ra
anchors.why: Read address selecting the output row slice.

groups.name: register_array
groups.description: 1-write 1-read register array with per-row write decode.
